exposure: postgraduate training of family physicians for South African district hospitals
outcome: Number and type of procedures performed
cohort: Patients undergoing procedures at a rural district hospital in South Africa
finding: There were adequate opportunities for teaching core surgical, obstetrics, and anaesthetics skills to postgraduate family medicine trainees based on the number and type of procedures performed at a rural district hospital in South Africa.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the second most common procedure performed, indicating adequate learning opportunities for this obstetric skill.
